title: Terazul
summary: Free-action stimulant gives the Terazul Jitters for 2 turns.

fields.Use: Consume without spending an Action or Bonus Action. +2 AC, Advantage on Dexterity saves, +30 ft movement, and one additional Action per turn.
fields.Stacking: Stacks with Hastened. Refreshing Terazul at one remaining turn can maintain its effect, but when stacked with Haste one source can expire and still cause Lethargic.
fields.Aftereffect: When the Jitters end, you are Lethargic for 1 turn and cannot move or take Actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions. Concentration stays active.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Severn in the Guildhall or find it in locations including Nortale’s Hostel, Philgrave’s Mansion and the Grey Harbour Docks.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
